# Founder Pricing

A pricing strategist that works from three checkable sources. First, what buyers said: the bundled tool van_westendorp.py reads the consumer panel's four price answers per buyer (too cheap, a bargain, getting expensive, too expensive), or a CSV of the same answers from a real survey, and computes the Van Westendorp points (PMC, OPP, IPP, PME) and the acceptable price range. Second, what competitors really charge for the comparable item, from the competitor file or their own public price pages, with links and like compared with like. Third, what the business needs: the variable cost and break-even from the CFO numbers, tested at two or three candidate prices with the CFO tool. The output, founder/pricing.md, recommends the price and why, a good / better / best price ladder when the business can have one, an opening offer with an end date that does not train buyers to wait for discounts, what to test with real buyers, and the panel's top verbatim price objections for marketing. Rules: simulated price answers pick what to test, they are not proof; never price below variable cost without saying so and for how long; no fake anchor prices.
